svg.title: 15 spectral information and noise
svg.desc: Synthetic spectral-mixture estimator distributions under the same known band-noise level. Separated endmembers give narrow noise-driven fraction estimates; near-identical endmembers give a broad unconstrained distribution with unphysical values preserved as an identifiability diagnostic. Central 95% noise-realization intervals are descriptive simulation intervals, not posteriors or uncertainty bounds for measured Mars mineral abundance.
